title: Author simple Python tests for mcp_hub MCP security and product behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies user-key can access seeded same-team task or project data.
A test verifies an ordinary participant read attempt for seeded cross-organization document data does not expose a seeded beta private-note marker.
A test verifies an ordinary participant comment listing for seeded cross-boundary work does not expose the seeded beta internal comment marker.
A test searches for an existing alpha document marker as a same-organization caller and asserts that the expected document is returned.
A test verifies an ordinary participant search result does not expose a seeded beta private-note marker.
A test verifies admin-key can access seeded cross-team project or task data.
The submitted tests define or use a visible setup step that runs before every test function to restore seeded application state, and no test reads IDs or objects created by another test function.
A test converts the denied ordinary-participant cross-boundary discovery result into a serialized string before asserting that the seeded beta task marker is absent.
Test that explicit expected values are used rather than broad truthiness checks.
The submitted tests define a serialization helper and reuse it in at least two test functions.
A test verifies user2-key can access seeded beta same-team task or project data and asserts a specific beta marker or seeded beta identifier.
A test serializes a denied user-key cross-team task or project access attempt and asserts the response does not expose a seeded beta marker.
